sample.wav is copied unmodified from go.senan.xyz/taglib's own test
fixtures (testdata/eg.wav) — already a direct dependency of this project
(see go.mod), licensed LGPL-2.1 (full text: the module's own LICENSE file,
https://pkg.go.dev/go.senan.xyz/taglib?tab=licenses). Used here to test
readTagLib, the WAV read path dhowden/tag can't cover (see tagreader.go's
package doc comment for why).

sample.opus is a local transcode of that same eg.wav (`opusenc --bitrate 32
eg.wav sample.opus`), used to confirm dhowden/tag really does correctly
read OpusTags via Read() end-to-end (it treats OpusTags as an alias of the
byte-identical VorbisComment structure — see ogg.go's opusTagsPrefix).
